_comment: POST this to /api/regulatory-updates to simulate the horizon-scanning provider. Facts verified against Rajah & Tann and Allen & Gledhill client alerts on the 2026 Notifications; announced at MOM Committee of Supply, 3 March 2026.
title: Retirement and Re-employment (Prescribed Minimum Retirement Age / Prescribed Re-employment Age) Notifications 2026

changes.source_span: the prescribed minimum retirement age for employees who attain 63 years of age on or after 1 July 2026 is 64 years of age
the prescribed re-employment age for employees who attain 68 years of age on or after 1 July 2026 is 69 years of age
